updates.note: Management stated they met all guidance parameters in the last financial year, and EBITDA was 30% for '25-'26.
updates.quote: As we told in the beginning of the year about the guidance, we have met all the guidance parameters in the last financial year.

updates.note: Revenue grew by 16% in '25-'26, achieving the 15% plus revenue growth target.
updates.quote: the revenue from operations has increased to INR27,480 crores in '25-'26 as compared to INR23,658 crores previous year with a growth of 16%.

updates.note: Management stated capital expenditure booked last year was INR900 crores, but guidance was achieved or superseded elsewhere. Wait, guidance was met generally.
updates.quote: last year, I think we had INR900 crores capital expenditure was booked.

updates.note: Reiterated export turnover goal of more than 10% over 4 to 5 years.
updates.quote: And the same thing is about exports, which is 4% to 5% right now over a period of time, but that period of time is around 4 to 5 years. We want to increase it to more than 10% of our turnover.

updates.note: R&D investment target for FY27 updated/reiterated to around INR2,200 crores.
updates.quote: So, this year, we have targeted a value of around INR2,200 crores investment in R&D.
nondefense right now, it is 8% to 10%. We wanted to steadily increase it to 15% to 20%.

new_promises.statement: We are retaining our revenue growth of more than 15% for '26-'27.
new_promises.quote: So, we are retaining our revenue growth of more than 15%. So definitely, we are going to have more than 15% as a revenue growth for '26-'27.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain

new_promises.statement: EBITDA margins will be more than 28% for '26-'27.
new_promises.quote: EBITDA margins will be more than 28%.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain

new_promises.statement: The order inflow we are expecting this year more than INR55,000 crores.
new_promises.quote: The order inflow we are expecting this year more than INR55,000 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain

new_promises.statement: Targeting more than INR1,200 crores as a capital investment for this year.
new_promises.quote: So, we are targeting more than INR1,200 crores as a capital investment for this year.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain

new_promises.statement: Defense to non-defense ratio will be 90% to 10% for the year.
new_promises.quote: And defense to non-defense ratio, more or less, it will be 90% to 10%, maybe plus/minus 1%.
new_promises.speaker: Manoj Jain
